name: forge-agent-tree
description: Side pane that shows the session's agents as a live tree: models, status, activity, context, advisor calls and a short event log. Switch the session's model, effort and advisor from the pane, choose what new subagents get, and switch a running one; in 23 languages.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when an interactive session starts (Claude Code seats it only in a wide terminal)

animate.title: Motion
animate.description: The spinner while Claude works; a light running along the bars and a pulse down every line of the tree, idle too

hud.title: Forge HUD
hud.description: The sci-fi look: rails, LED bars, a neon palette and a navy plate on a dark theme; off: the classic look

columns.title: Width
columns.description: Columns the docked pane asks for; a width dragged by hand wins

logRows.title: Log rows
logRows.description: How many log rows the pane shows (0 to 20; the narrow view at most one); 0 hides the log

limitWarnAt.title: Limits: yellow from
limitWarnAt.description: The share (%) of the session or all-models limit from which its bar turns yellow

limitAlertAt.title: Limits: red from
limitAlertAt.description: The share (%) of the session or all-models limit from which its bar turns red; above the yellow one

bandLine.title: Line above the prompt
bandLine.description: While the pane is closed, a line above the prompt sums up the agents, drawn as token-weather draws its own

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Every sound of the pane at once; each event has its own switch on the sounds page (o, then Sound events)

advisorSound.title: Sound: advisor call
advisorSound.description: An uplink chirp at each advisor call (with Sound on)

soundSpawn.title: Sound: agent deployed
soundSpawn.description: A rising bloop when a subagent starts (a workflow’s agents make none) (with Sound on)

soundDone.title: Sound: agent done
soundDone.description: Two rising chimes when an agent or a workflow run finishes well (with Sound on)

soundFailed.title: Sound: agent failed
soundFailed.description: Falling tones when an agent or a workflow run fails (with Sound on)

soundWaiting.title: Sound: agent waiting
soundWaiting.description: A sonar ping when an agent starts waiting for you (with Sound on)

soundTurn.title: Sound: turn complete
soundTurn.description: A bell arpeggio when the main session’s answer is done (with Sound on)

soundAlert.title: Sound: red alert
soundAlert.description: A klaxon when the context reaches 90% or a limit its red mark (with Sound on)

soundBoot.title: Sound: power-up
soundBoot.description: When the pane first opens in a session (with Sound on)

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: Every notification of the pane at once, through Claude Code's notification channel; where it has none in the terminal, on Windows a Windows notification. Each event has its own switch on the notifications page (o, then Notification events)

notifyWaiting.title: Notify: agent waiting
notifyWaiting.description: When an agent starts waiting for you (with Notifications on)

notifyFailed.title: Notify: failure
notifyFailed.description: When an agent or a workflow run fails (with Notifications on)

notifyRun.title: Notify: workflow done
notifyRun.description: When a workflow run finishes well (with Notifications on)

notifyTurn.title: Notify: turn complete
notifyTurn.description: When the main session’s answer is done (with Notifications on)

notifyAlert.title: Notify: red alert
notifyAlert.description: When the context reaches 90% or a limit its red mark (with Notifications on)

noticeGap.title: Notification gap
noticeGap.description: Seconds between two notifications of a kind; what comes meanwhile is merged into the next (0 sends each at once; the notifications page offers 0, 5, 10, 20, 30 and 60)

autoUpdate.title: Auto-update
autoUpdate.description: Once a day, at an interactive start, a copy installed from a marketplace reads the version on GitHub and, when it is newer, runs claude plugin update (see PRIVACY.md)
